items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: he was playing with P-Ron's band.

ctx.x: He really showed you then. You didn't just listen to him, he showed you how to...
But he used to show me how to execute things because he, at that time he didn't read, he was playing with P-Ron's band.
Yes, I knew you were playing.
